conceptual_change: Implement the ATR-based conditional volatility filter by hard-coding the entry restriction logic into the execution engine to prevent order submission when ATR_14 is greater than 1.5 standard deviations above its 20-period moving average.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt (BTC_1h_018) was rejected because it proposed a logical constraint without providing the required engine implementation to execute that constraint. This hypothesis satisfies the requirement by explicitly defining the implementation step for the volatility filter.
